Models developed through battlefield analysis and energy engineering allow us to reproduce the basic structure of Dark Fog Energy Shards. Fusing an energetic carbon medium with combustible units and stabilizing it in glass yields synthetic shards for further Dark Fog engineering.
Synthetic Energy Shard production is now available. Smelters can transform conventional industrial materials into this stable energy carrier.
dark_fog_synthesis.tech.information_topo: Signal-response models and precision optics provide a new approach to Dark Fog information structures. Using a crystalline silicon substrate, optical coupling, plasma excitation, and stable encapsulation, matrix labs can construct an information medium with the characteristics of a Dark Fog Matrix.
A synthetic construction method for Dark Fog Matrices is now available. Matrix labs can produce them from precision industrial components, enabling further research into Dark Fog technology.
dark_fog_synthesis.recipe.energy_shard.d: Smelt 1 combustible unit, 1 energetic graphite, and 1 glass into 2 energy shards. Base time: 2 seconds.
dark_fog_synthesis.recipe.dark_fog_matri: Combine 2 crystalline silicon, 1 photon combiner, 1 plasma exciter, and 1 titanium glass in a matrix lab to produce 1 Dark Fog Matrix. Base time: 4 seconds.
dark_fog_synthesis.recipe.silicon_neuron: Assemble 2 microcrystalline components, 2 titanium alloy, and 2 crystalline silicon into 1 silicon-based neuron. Base time: 4 seconds.
dark_fog_synthesis.recipe.matter_recombi: Assemble 1 plane filter, 2 super-magnetic rings, 2 hydrogen, and 2 crystalline silicon into 1 matter recombinator. Base time: 6 seconds.
dark_fog_synthesis.recipe.negentropy_sin: Assemble 1 strange matter, 2 Casimir crystals, 1 deuteron fuel rod, and 2 crystalline silicon into 1 negentropy singularity. Base time: 8 seconds.
dark_fog_synthesis.recipe.core_element.d: Assemble 2 antimatter, 2 frame materials, 2 super-magnetic rings, and 4 crystalline silicon into 1 core element. Base time: 10 seconds.
dark_fog_synthesis.config.non_peace.name: Also apply combat prerequisites in non-Peace saves
dark_fog_synthesis.config.non_peace.desc: Peace saves always use the four added combat prerequisites. Default: false. Restart the game after changing this setting. This setting does not disable recipes or either new technology.
